description:
Intent i004 (SNAPSHOT=s01, branch=proc-config-write-unterminated) complete. Three findings written to agent-state/findings/i004.json, all with untrusted source, violated terminator invariant, unsafe string use, and exact source evidence:

1. drivers/s390/cio/cio_inject.c:98-103 (HIGH): crw_inject_write does `buffer = vmemdup_user(buf, lbuf)` — an exactly lbuf-sized allocation with no NUL terminator — then `rc = sscanf(buffer, "%x %x %x %x %x %x %x", ...)` which scans until NUL and reads past the allocation. kvfree immediately after confirms the buffer is exactly the user copy. Structurally identical to the seed's memdup_user+sscanf bug; root-only 0200 debugfs error-injection file gated behind enable_inject, s390-only.

2. drivers/net/ethernet/brocade/bna/bnad_debugfs.c:315-319 (HIGH): bnad_debugfs_write_regrd does `kern_buf = memdup_user(buf, nbytes)` then `rc = sscanf(kern_buf, "%x:%x", &addr, &len)` with no terminator write or bounded parse; the regwr sibling at line 375 (`sscanf(kern_buf, "%x:%x", &addr, &val)`) has the identical defect. This is the exact seed API and shape (bna is the Brocade BNA sibling of scsi bfa).

3. arch/um/kernel/exitcode.c:42-52 (MEDIUM): /proc/exitcode write handler copies `min(count, sizeof(buf))` bytes into a 7-byte stack array — when count >= 7 the entire array is filled with no +1 terminator slot — then `tmp = simple_strtol(buf, &end, 0)` scans one byte past the array and `*end` dereferences it. UML-only, 0600 root-only, 1-byte stack OOB read.

Evidence-backed negatives (safe, all with concrete terminator or bounded-consumer evidence): fs/proc/base.c:2775 proc_pid_attr_write (apparmor do_setattr re-allocates kmalloc(size+1) and writes args[size]='\0'; selinux security_context_to_sid_core uses kmemdup_nul; smack smk_parse_smack is len-bounded with kstrndup); security/smack/smackfs.c:2548 (smk_parse_smack bounded loop + kstrndup); drivers/acpi/proc.c:101 (strbuf[count]='\0'); arch/powerpc/kernel/rtas-proc.c:315 (progress_led[count]=0); rtas_flash.c:419 (strncmp with fixed length 1); arch/alpha/kernel/srm_env.c:105 (buf[count]='\0'); fs/proc/generic.c:812 and lib/dynamic_debug.c:1011 (memdup_user_nul); fs/configfs/file.c:192 (fill_write_buffer writes buffer->page[copied]=0, so all configfs ->store_* callbacks receive terminated buffers); kernel/sched/psi.c:1527; net/netfilter/xt_recent.c:574 (strnchr/in*_pton with explicit size); fs/smb/client/cifs_debug.c:1100 (memset + count<=11); net/core/pktgen.c:531 (data[count-1]=0); drivers/pnp/pnpbios/proc.c:199 (non-string binary consumption).

Unresolved/limitations: fs/ntfs3/super.c:505 ntfs3_label_write (kmalloc(count) with no +1, downstream ntfs_set_label not read) and sound/core/info.c:326 (zeroed page-buffer, per-entry c.text.write callbacks not enumerated); debugfs-branch sites found in the same sweep (ice_debugfs.c x4, rvu_debugfs.c:1002, qedf_debugfs.c:173) deferred to branch1/i002. No compiler/KASAN reproducer was run (read-only snapshot); classification rests on source reading of the copy call, size argument, and unbounded C-string consumer.
